messages:
maria_cs: FYI customer acct_9876 says voucher VOUCHER-ACME-2026 redeemed but ended up applying to Hosted (hosted-standard) not Dedicated. They bought dedicated capacity — needs credit moved. They pasted console success but allocation shows hosted. Can someone check?
kevin_billing: @maria_cs can you paste the redemption payload or screenshot? is the voucher single-use or tenant-scoped?
ops-bot: Ticket created in Zendesk: ZD-1842 by maria_cs
mar ia_cs: attaching sanitized snippet — console says \"Redeemed successfully\":
```
POST /api/v1/promos/redeem
{
  \"code\": \"VOUCHER-ACME-2026\",
  \"account_id\": \"acct_9876\",
  \"target\": \"auto\"
}
```
kevin_billing: thanks. Looks like the promo was only configured to target \"hosted\" SKUs in the promo admin UI. That would auto-assign hosted credits even if customer asked for dedicated.
rahul_support: quick repro steps: customer redeemed from console -> backend created credit record promo_credit_5544 with sku=hosted-standard -> balance applied to hosted billing bucket.
rahul_support: Can we change sku on that promo_credit_5544 to dedicated-monthly? is there a safe path to avoid double-charging? :thinking_face:
kevin_billing: We can't directly change historical allocation records via billing API. Two options: 1) create equivalent dedicated credit manually and revoke the hosted credit (issue negative entry) or 2) leave hosted credit and give additional dedicated credit then mark as resolved. Which does Finance prefer?
jenna_escalation: tagging finance offline. For customer experience, option 1 is cleaner — move value, not double-credit. I'll coordinate.
kevin_billing: OK. Rahul - can you send me the promo metadata from promo-admin for VOUCHER-ACME-2026 (scopes, allowed_skus, single_use flag)?
rahul_support: copied metadata: allowed_skus: [\"hosted-standard\"], single_use: true, scope: account-level, issued_by: sales-team. It was misconfigured at grant time.
maria_cs: customer says they redeemed 2 weeks ago and are blocked from provisioning Dedicated pool because no dedicated credits. They need temporary coverage for dedicated until we fix.
jenna_escalation: I'll provision a manual dedicated credit for acct_9876 for the same dollar amount. finance, please create CREDIT-DA-9876 and revoke promo_credit_5544 once confirmed.
kevin_billing: action items: (1) rahul - export promo_credit_5544 id and redemption record; (2) jenna - manual dedicated credit created & visible to customer; (3) finance - reverse hosted allocation after manual credit posted.
rahul_support: promo_credit_5544 record: id=pc_5544, redeemed_at=2026-06-03T18:22:10Z, original_amount_cents=250000, sku=hosted-standard, redeemed_by=acct_9876. I've DM'd kevin the full logs.
ops-bot: Audit log: promo VOUCHER-ACME-2026 edited 2026-05-15 by sales-onboarding (changed allowed_skus -> hosted-standard)
kevin_billing: jenna — can you confirm when manual credit is applied so I can trigger reversal?
jenna_escalation: manual dedicated credit CREDIT-DA-9876 posted for $2500. Customer confirmed they can now allocate to Dedicated pool. :white_check_mark:
maria_cs: customer confirmed dedicated pool provisioning succeeded. They appreciate quick help.
kevin_billing: finance processed reversal of hosted allocation promo_credit_5544 (negative entry issued). Balance now reflects only dedicated credit.
rahul_support: marked root cause as misconfigured promo (allowed_skus missing dedicated). PR opened to add validation to promo-admin UI to require allowed_skus when issuing dedicated-scoped vouchers.
jenna_escalation: tagging this resolved on our side, will follow up with sales team to reissue correct voucher templates. :handshake:
maria_cs: closing thread with customer note. Thanks all. :tada:
